description: US airport delay status from the FAA NAS Status feed (ground delay programs, ground stops, closures, arrival/departure delays) plus OurAirports metadata (name, city, ICAO/IATA, lat/lon). Pass ?airport=SFO (IATA) or KSFO (ICAO), or omit for a nationwide overview. Public-domain sources. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/airport-status
name: airport_status
title: Airport Status
